evidence_items.explanation: The reported operating loss is consistent with the financial premise. It is not a matching net-income measure and does not identify unreliability as a cause.

Reuters relays The Information's account of $2.5 billion in first-half cash burn and substantial research and development costs. This supplies qualified cost context, but cash burn is not net loss and the report does not isolate costs caused by unreliability.

The article relays an October paid-user compute margin of 70%, improved from 52% at the end of 2024, with no public company confirmation. Improving serving economics qualify a blanket inefficiency explanation, but this later-period contribution measure does not establish company-wide profit.
